verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs show you can bulk add or edit the Chart of Accounts by CSV upload from Company Settings, and a Classifications FAQ shows a class dimension with unlimited Groups. Neither source documents configuring account types or creating sub-account hierarchies. missing for 10: documented account-type configuration, sub-account/parent-child hierarchy support, in-app (non-CSV) COA editing details, tag dimensions beyond classes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
a user can create an unlimited number of Groups for Classes
